text:
rachel: Quick sync: new Aurum Health POC. They have a 13B finetune and want Dedicated with BYOK + HSM. Need onboarding preflight and pricing delta for quant vs fp16.

tom: Preflight checklist I'll send: model.safetensors, tokenizer.json, config.json, sample_eval.json (50 prompts), prompt_length_hist.csv, list of custom ops.

priya: Security: BYOK supported on Dedicated. We'll need artifact access list and rotation proof. I'll draft the responses.

ben: Infra note: KV cache ok for median 512 tokens, but tails to 2k need a high-memory route. Recommend prefix caching + per-customer KV namespace.

tom: Compatibility caveat: custom quant layout will require re-quant (1-2 days). Ask them to export standard q4_0 if possible.

rachel: Pricing: rough multipliers q4_0=0.6x, q8=0.78x, fp16=1.0x. Reserved 12mo commit gets extra 12-15% off. I'll draft an estimate.

infra-bot: resource-check created RR-9912 for Dedicated pool sizing (owner: ben).

priya: Contract asks: DPA + SOC2 attestation ok. For log access we can provide artifact event exports. BYOK clause needed.

tom: I'll run a fast compatibility pass once artifacts are uploaded. Validation command: python infra/validate_model.py --model s3://aurum/model.safetensors --tokenizer s3://aurum/tokenizer.json --eval sample_eval.json

rachel: Action items: Aurum upload artifacts; tom run compat; ben confirm pool sizing and routing; priya draft security responses; I'll share pricing one-pager. :thumbsup:
